name: kiki-jlpt
description: Local JLPT N5 listening-practice generator with review and Gemini TTS.

scripts.build:practice: npm run library:build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.practice.json && vite build --config vite.practice.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test src/addAllAudio.test.ts src/consumer/conversationOrdering.test.ts src/studioRunSelection.test.ts src/studioCurationScope.test.ts src/studioCuration.test.tsx server/vocabAudit.test.ts server/vocabularyReferences.test.ts server/prompt.test.ts server/textModels.test.ts server/claudeText.test.ts server/qualityControl.test.ts server/historicalQuality.test.ts server/aiCuration.test.ts server/studioJobs.test.ts server/studioApi.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build
